描述_EN: another event featured on the silk newspaper looks forward to shanghai expo 2010, the first international exposition to be held in china. it commemorates the launch of the space shuttle shenzhou 6, china's second manned space flight, launched on 12 october 2005, the 2nd anniversary of the launch of its predecessor, shenzhou 5. it also symbolically links one of the oldest forms of technology (silk production) with one of the most modern (space travel).the front page of this memorial edition features a reprint of the article ‘on earth’, one of the earliest journalistic essays published in 1872 by shenbao, a pioneering newspaper based in shanghai. for many centuries in china the educated classes used silk for writing. the space mission was carried out by astronauts fei junlong and nie haisheng, and among the objects that travelled with them on the spacecraft were a silk newspaper and limited copies of a commemorative first day cover, which the jiefang daily press group produced. this newspaper revives the use of silk to communicate ideas, but with modern printing methods. this newspaper printed on silk was given to the v&a in summer 2007 by the shanghai press group, jiefang daily. this printed silk is a facsimile of the original that travelled into space.
描述_ZN: 《丝绸报》上的另一个事件是对2010年上海世博会的期待，这是在中国举办的第一个国际博览会。 它是为了纪念神舟六号航天飞机的发射，这是中国的第二次载人航天飞行，于2005年10月12日发射，是其前身神舟五号发射的两周年。 它也象征性地将最古老的技术形式之一（丝绸生产）与最现代的技术形式之一（太空旅行）联系起来。这个纪念版的头版以重印 "在地球上 "一文为特色，这是1872年由位于上海的先驱报纸《申博》出版的最早的新闻论文之一。 在中国，许多世纪以来，有教养的阶级都用丝绸来书写。 这次太空任务由宇航员费俊龙和聂海胜执行，与他们一起乘坐飞船的物品中包括一份丝绸报纸和解放日报报业集团制作的纪念首日封的限量版。 这份报纸恢复了使用丝绸来交流思想，但用的是现代印刷方法。 这份印在丝绸上的报纸是2007年夏天由上海报业集团《解放日报》赠送给V&A的。 这个印刷的丝绸是进入太空的原件的复制品。
